meta.name: genomic-coordinates
meta.description: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions, normalise and compare variant representations, and detect assembly or contig-naming mismatches before they corrupt an analysis. Use whenever coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary - converting between BED, GFF/GTF, VCF, SAM/BAM, WIG, PSL, genePred, Picard interval_list, or region strings; reconciling 0-based half-open with 1-based inclusive; left-aligning or trimming indels; checking whether two variant records describe the same change; mapping genomic to transcript, CDS, or protein positions; auditing a BED/GTF/VCF for convention violations; or diagnosing GRCh37 vs hg19 vs GRCh38 vs T2T, chr-prefix, and liftover problems. Triggers include "off by one", "0-based", "1-based", "half-open", "coordinate system", "left-align", "normalize variant", "bcftools norm", "chr prefix", "wrong genome build", "liftover", "REF mismatch", and "HGVS".

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能转换不同坐标系统(如 BED 与 GFF 互转)、规范化并比较变异表示、检查基因组组装或命名是否匹配,并报告坐标是否越界等问题。
howto.when: 当用户提到“off by one”、“坐标系统”、“liftover”等关键词,或要求转换坐标、规范化变异、检查组装一致性时触发。

say.note: Claude 会调用转换脚本并说明转换方向

say.text: 用 ref.fa 把 chr1:7:CAC:C 左对齐规范化
say.note: Claude 会检查参考序列并给出规范化结果

say.text: 检查这个 VCF 和 GTF 是否用了同一个参考基因组

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert between coordinate conventions (e.g., BED to GFF), normalize and compare variant representations, and detect assembly or contig naming mismatches, reporting issues like out-of-bound coordinates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "off by one", "coordinate system", or "liftover", or asks to convert coordinates, normalize variants, or check assembly consistency.

say_en.text: Convert this zero-based BED interval to one-based GFF format
say_en.note: Claude runs the conversion script and states the direction

say_en.text: Left-align and normalize chr1:7:CAC:C using ref.fa
say_en.note: Claude checks the reference and returns a normalized variant

say_en.text: Check if this VCF and GTF use the same reference genome
say_en.note: Claude compares lengths and naming, reporting mismatches
